goal: contextos serve: run the MCP server over HTTP on 127.0.0.1 so a tunnel (ngrok fixed domain) can put it on the internet. Protection by secret link: the only working path is /<secret>/mcp, everything else is 404. The secret comes from CONTEXTOS_SECRET or a file next to the database, made on first run (token_urlsafe(32)); --new-secret replaces it. --public-host adds the tunnel domain to the allowed Host headers. Access logs are off so the secret is never written to logs. README explains setup with ngrok and claude.ai / ChatGPT connectors.
